anti_abuse: No self-referral: referrer_id == referred_id is rejected by the CHECK constraint and by the service layer
One reward per referred subscriber: UNIQUE (referrer_id, referred_id)
A referred subscriber counts only once, even if they rejoin later
Reward is granted only after the referred subscriber activates with a confirmed manual payment (recorded in supabase.payments by Mohamed)
No reward for a referred subscriber who never activates, is kicked, or was already a subscriber
Referral links are Telegram deep links only — no tracking pixels, no third-party analytics
Admin audit: every reward grant is an admin_audit row (action 'referral:reward')
No duplicate accounts: a referred Telegram id that already exists as a subscriber cannot earn a second reward
db_tables: supabase.referrals — invite_code, status invited/activated/rewarded/rejected, reward_days, reward_granted_at
hard_rules: Reward is subscription DAYS only — never cash, never EGP/USD payout, never a broker deposit
No broker anywhere: no Pocket Option link, no deposit tier, no deposit requirement
No referral earnings are advertised as money — the reward is days of Gold Council membership
No fake counts: invited/earned numbers shown to a user come only from supabase.referrals rows for that user
workflow.name: gold-council-referral

reward.grant_condition: referred subscriber activates via a confirmed manual payment
reward.note: 7 days is the design default. Mohamed decides the final number before Phase E build.

steps.description: Referrer opens the WebApp profile tab or sends /invite; the bot returns their personal link: https://t.me/GoldCouncil_bot?start=ref_<referrer telegram id>
steps.name: Generate personal invite link

steps.description: A new user taps the link and starts the bot with start=ref_<id>. The bot records referrals row (status='invited', invite_code=ref_<id>) and subscribers.referred_by=<referrer id>. If the user is already a subscriber, the referral is rejected (status='rejected').
steps.name: Track the tap

steps.description: The referred user contacts Mohamed, transfers, and Mohamed activates them manually (dashboard or /admin). A payments row is recorded. referrals status becomes 'activated'.
steps.name: Activation via manual payment

steps.description: On activation, the service grants reward_days to the referrer (extends their expires_at by that many days), sets referrals.status='rewarded' and reward_granted_at=now(), and writes an admin_audit row. The referrer gets a message stating the extra days — no money, no cash value.
steps.name: Grant reward days

steps.description: Progress tab / /stats shows the referrer their invited count and total reward days earned — from supabase.referrals only.
steps.name: Show referral progress
